classes.name: AgendaItemsComp
classes.description:
Represents the agenda items list on the meeting show page.
Each agenda item shows a title, duration, and action menu.

The root is the agenda list wrapper rendered by
`MeetingAgendaItems::ListComponent`, whose id comes from OpenProject's
`component_wrapper` helper (`name.underscore.tr('/', '-').tr('_', '-')`).

The "Add" split button is deliberately **outside** this root: the meeting
show page renders it as a sibling row via `MeetingAgendaItems::NewButtonComponent`,
tagged `data-test-selector="meeting-main-add-button"`.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description:
Adds an agenda item with the given title: opens the "Add" split button,
picks "Agenda item" from the dropdown, fills the title, saves, and waits
for the saved item to render in the list.

Saving falls back to pressing Enter when no Save button is visible.
methods.prerequisites: The meeting detail page is open and the meeting is not closed
methods.observableState: A new agenda item with this title appears in the agenda list

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of list items in the agenda list.
methods.prerequisites: The meeting detail page is open
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

methods.name: hasItemWithTitle
methods.description:
Checks whether text matching the given title is visible in the agenda
list. Matches any text within the list, not only item titles.
methods.prerequisites: The meeting detail page is open
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

classes.name: MeetingFormDialogComp
classes.description:
Represents the create/edit meeting dialog (#new-meeting-dialog).
Contains fields for title, location, start time, and duration.

methods.name: fillTitle
methods.description:
Fills the meeting title field. Returns this component so calls can be
chained with {@link fillLocation} and {@link clickCreate}.
methods.prerequisites: The create/edit meeting dialog is open
methods.observableState: The title field contains the given text

methods.name: fillLocation
methods.description:
Fills the meeting location field. Returns this component so calls can be
chained with {@link fillTitle} and {@link clickCreate}.
methods.prerequisites: The create/edit meeting dialog is open
methods.observableState: The location field contains the given text

methods.name: clickCreate
methods.description: Clicks Create to submit the meeting form.
methods.prerequisites: The create meeting dialog is open and the required title is filled
methods.observableState: The meeting is created, the dialog closes, and the browser navigates to the new meeting's detail page

methods.name: createMeeting
methods.description:
Creates a meeting in one call — shorthand for {@link fillTitle}, then
{@link fillLocation} when a location is given, then {@link clickCreate}.
Leaves date, time and duration at their dialog defaults.
methods.prerequisites: The create meeting dialog is open
methods.observableState: The meeting is created with the given title and appears in the meetings list; the browser navigates to its detail page

classes.name: MeetingShowPage
classes.description:
Represents the meeting detail/show page at /projects/:id/meetings/:meeting_id.
Contains the meeting header with title and action menu,
an agenda items section, and a side panel with details/participants.

methods.name: getMeetingTitle
methods.description:
Returns the meeting's title from the page heading, or an empty string if
the heading has no text content.
methods.prerequisites: The meeting detail page is open
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

methods.name: agendaItems
methods.description:
Returns the agenda items component, used to add agenda items and assert
on the meeting's agenda.
methods.prerequisites: The meeting detail page is open
methods.observableState: None — returns a component wrapper without interacting

methods.name: sidePanel
methods.description:
Returns the side panel component, covering meeting details (date, time,
duration, location), state controls, and participants.
methods.prerequisites: The meeting detail page is open
methods.observableState: None — returns a component wrapper without interacting

methods.name: openHeaderActionMenu
methods.description:
Opens the meeting's header action ("kebab") menu, which holds the Delete
and Close actions.
methods.prerequisites: The meeting detail page is open
methods.observableState: The header action menu opens, exposing its menu items

methods.name: deleteMeeting
methods.description:
Deletes this meeting end to end: opens the header action menu, clicks
Delete, and confirms in the dialog.

Does not wait for or assert the resulting navigation, so callers that
need the meetings list should navigate to it explicitly.
methods.prerequisites: The meeting detail page is open and the current user may delete the meeting
methods.observableState: The meeting is permanently deleted and no longer appears in the meetings list

methods.name: closeMeeting
methods.description:
Closes the meeting, moving its state from Draft/Open to Closed, via the
header action menu. Closing is not the same as deleting — the meeting
remains listed.
methods.prerequisites: The meeting detail page is open and the meeting is not already closed
methods.observableState: The meeting's state becomes Closed and its agenda becomes read-only

classes.name: MeetingSidePanelComp
classes.description:
Represents the meeting side panel on the meeting show page.
Contains meeting details (date, time, duration, location),
state controls, and participants list.

The root is the wrapper rendered by `Meetings::SidePanelComponent`, whose id
comes from OpenProject's `component_wrapper` helper
(`name.underscore.tr('/', '-').tr('_', '-')`).

Both controls are `link`s, not buttons, and OpenProject does not emit a
`data-test-selector` for either despite the ERB requesting one — verified
against a live ARIA snapshot. "Manage participants" appears twice inside the
panel (section header and participant list), hence `.first()`.

methods.name: clickEditDetails
methods.description:
Clicks the edit details button to open the meeting details dialog, where
date, time, duration and location can be changed.
methods.prerequisites: The meeting detail page is open and the current user may edit the meeting
methods.observableState: The edit meeting details dialog opens, pre-filled with the current values

methods.name: clickManageParticipants
methods.description:
Clicks the manage participants button to open the participants dialog,
where invitees and attendees are selected.
methods.prerequisites: The meeting detail page is open and the current user may edit participants
methods.observableState: The manage participants dialog opens, listing project members with invited/attended checkboxes

methods.name: getDetailsText
methods.description:
Returns the meeting details text block, which includes the date, time,
zone, duration and — when set — the location.

The location has no element of its own: OpenProject renders it via
`render_meeting_attribute_row(:location)` as an Octicon plus bare text,
with no id, class, or test selector. A live ARIA snapshot shows it merged
into one text run, e.g. `07/22/2026 10:00 AM - 11:00 AM UTC 1 hr Room 42`.
So this cannot return the location alone — assert with `toContain`.
methods.prerequisites: The meeting detail page is open
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

classes.name: MeetingsPage
classes.description:
Represents the meetings list page at /projects/:id/meetings.
Shows meetings grouped by date with options to create, filter, and navigate.
The "New Meeting" button is a split button with a dropdown for one-time vs recurring.

methods.name: clickAddOneTimeMeeting
methods.description:
Clicks the "New Meeting" split button and selects "One-time" from its
dropdown, opening the meeting creation dialog.
methods.prerequisites: The meetings list page is open
methods.observableState: The create meeting dialog (#new-meeting-dialog) opens with empty title, location, date, time and duration fields

methods.name: clickMeetingByTitle
methods.description: Clicks a meeting's title link to open its detail page.
methods.prerequisites: The meetings list page is open and a meeting with this title is listed in the current tab
methods.observableState: The browser navigates to the meeting detail page at `/meetings/:id`

methods.name: clickUpcomingTab
methods.description:
Switches to the "Upcoming" meetings tab and waits for the page load.
Returns the same page instance rather than a fresh one.
methods.prerequisites: The meetings list page is open
methods.observableState: The list reloads showing only meetings scheduled in the future

methods.name: clickPastTab
methods.description:
Switches to the "Past" meetings tab and waits for the page load.
Returns the same page instance rather than a fresh one.
methods.prerequisites: The meetings list page is open
methods.observableState: The list reloads showing only meetings that have already occurred

methods.name: hasMeetingWithTitle
methods.description:
Checks whether a meeting with the given title is visible in the list.
Scoped to the active tab, so an existing past meeting reads as absent
while the Upcoming tab is selected.
methods.prerequisites: The meetings list page is open
methods.observableState: None — read-only query

methods.name: getMeetingCount
methods.description:
Returns the number of list items in the meetings content area.

Counts every `listitem` under `main`, so any other list rendered in the
content area inflates the result. Prefer
{@link hasMeetingWithTitle} when asserting about a specific meeting.
methods.prerequisites: The meetings list page is open
methods.observableState: None — read-only query
